{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Confirm only two channels exist
assert len(data['channel'].unique()) == 2, "There are only two channels, not three. The premise is false."

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
# First, confirm revenue is string type
assert data['revenue'].dtype == 'object', "Revenue must be string to parse"
data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders and QA orders
# QA orders: revenue == 999999.99
# Refunded orders: status == 'refunded'
valid_data = data[(data['status'] == 'completed') & (data['revenue'] != 999999.99)]

# Check that no QA or refunded orders remain
assert valid_data[valid_data['revenue'] == 999999.99].shape[0] == 0, "QA orders not filtered"
assert valid_data[valid_data['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0] == 0, "Refunded orders not filtered"

# Compute total revenue per channel
channel_revenue = valid_data.groupby('channel')['revenue'].sum().reset_index()
print(f"Total revenue per channel:\n{channel_revenue}")

# Identify the channel with highest revenue
max_channel = channel_revenue.loc[channel_revenue['revenue'].idxmax(), 'channel']
max_revenue = channel_revenue['revenue'].max()

print(f"Channel with highest revenue: {max_channel} ($ {max_revenue:,.2f})")"}
